name: Cartoon series
about: A cartoon series: a bible with a 3D cartoon look, a girl and her cat, a Screenplay with a sample — a shot per line.

data.text:
Cartoon series: an episode from a screenplay.

1. Series is the bible: title, look, world, characters, «Previously». The same node goes into every episode (copy the graph); «Add to Previously» on the Screenplay appends the episode's summary.
2. Heroes: the looks are filled in; your own portrait: «Hero photo» → «Describe from photo». With a photo every shot keeps the face (Ref2VA).
3. Screenplay: text as «SCENE 1. Place, time.» / «NAME (how): line» / «— action» (the lines are spoken as written). Edit it by hand or press «Write the screenplay» (from the Idea and the Series).
4. «Expand into shots»: a Prompt and a Scene per line and action (one speaks, the other listens), then a Montage and an Output.
5. «Export .srt»: the lines' subtitles, timed by the shot lengths.

data.title: Masha and Murzik
data.style: Bright warm colours, soft shapes, expressive faces
data.world: A cosy city flat: a kitchen with yellow curtains and a big fridge.
data.characters: Masha is a cheerful owner who gets angry fast and calms down fast. Murzik is a sly ginger cat who denies everything.

data.title: Episode idea
data.text: In the morning Masha finds the cheese gone from the fridge, and Murzik pretends he has nothing to do with it.

data.title: Screenplay
data.text:
SCENE 1. Kitchen, morning.
MASHA (angrily): Did you eat all the cheese again?
MURZIK (smiling): It wasn't me.
— Murzik hides his tail behind his back.
MASHA (calmly): Then where did the crumbs on your whiskers come from?
MURZIK (softly): It's... from a cracker.
